latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the design-style skill to power visually distinctive frontend/UI work.
- Automatically identifies and applies specific design system prompts (e.g., Neo-brutalism, Modern Dark) for projects involving frontend design, web pages, or UI components.
- Supports a wide range of design systems, from Material and Cyberpunk to FlatDesign and Retro, with clear style-matching guidance.
- Encourages proactive invocation for any frontend or UI-related tasks, not just when style is explicitly mentioned.
- Includes detailed workflow for selecting styles, retrieving design tokens, and ensuring produced code matches both aesthetic and technical requirements.
